name: Nam tok with grilled pork
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai moo nam tok (8 oz pork neck or shoulder for 4: 1 tbsp each of fish sauce and lime juice, 1/4 cup shallots, herbs, 2 tbsp toasted rice powder) and Eating Thai Food's nam tok (250 g grilled sliced meat a plate, 2 tbsp fish sauce). Per plate 100 g of cooked roast pork shoulder.
